description:
CapTech Sports is hiring Data Engineers to build the pipelines and platforms behind fan, consumer, brand, and media data for leagues, tours, federations, teams, brands, partners, and rights holders. You will work with first-party data such as ticketing, streaming, app, CRM, loyalty, commerce, and sponsorship, and with brand and media data from owned channels, paid media, and partners, including third-party sources. You will turn it into a trusted view of the fan and the audience that teams can use for engagement, personalization, media measurement, and sponsorship value. 
 We are hiring several engineers across a wide range of experience. Early-career builders will grow under senior engineers and architects. Experienced engineers will own designs, lead workstreams, and mentor the team. Everyone ships production code and works directly with client teams. 
 What You’ll Do 
 Build and operate batch and streaming pipelines that ingest first-party data from ticketing, streaming, app, CRM, loyalty, commerce, and email and marketing platforms. 

 Ingest brand and media data: paid and owned media performance, social, broadcast and streaming audience data, sponsorship and brand tracking, and platform and partner feeds. 

 Integrate third-party data, such as syndicated audience and consumer data, data clean rooms, and partner-shared datasets, and manage the contracts and usage limits that come with it. 

 Implement entity and identity resolution so one fan is one record across ticketing, streaming, app, retail, and media touchpoints, and match first-party records to third-party audiences. 

 Model and transform raw data into trusted, documented fan, consumer, brand, and media datasets, including audience segments, engagement metrics, and campaign performance. 

 Apply consent, privacy, and access controls to fan and consumer data from the first line of the pipeline, with clear separation of first-party and third-party data rights. 

 Deliver data products and APIs that power personalization, campaign activation, media and sponsorship measurement, marketing mix analysis, and AI use cases. 

 Add data quality tests, monitoring, and lineage so problems surface before clients find them. 

 Work with architects, strategists, and analysts to turn requirements into designs, and contribute to estimates and technical proposals. 

 Document your work and explain it clearly to client engineers and business stakeholders. 

 With experience: own pipeline and platform designs end to end, lead workstreams, review code, and mentor other engineers. 

 
 Technical Skills & Tools:
 Area:
 What we look for 
 Languages 
 Python and SQL, written for production 
 Data platforms 
 Databricks, Snowflake, Spark; lakehouse and warehouse patterns 
 Transformation and orchestration 
 dbt, Airflow, or equivalent 
 Cloud 
 AWS, Azure, or GCP, including storage, compute, and managed data services 
 Customer data 
 Customer data platform patterns, entity and identity resolution, master data management 
 Media and brand data 
 Ad platform and media measurement APIs, social and audience data feeds, clean rooms (such as Snowflake or Databricks clean rooms) 
 Source integration 
 REST and event-based integrations with ticketing, CRM, commerce, marketing, and third-party data providers 
 Privacy and consent 
 Consent management and privacy regimes such as CCPA and GDPR; first-party versus third-party data governance 
 Engineering practice 
 Git, CI/CD, infrastructure as code (such as Terraform), automated testing 
 Qualifications 
 We do not set a single years-of-experience bar for this role. We hire data engineers across a broad range and assess depth, judgment, and ownership. What we expect grows with experience: 
 Every engineer: Strong Python and SQL, and hands-on delivery of data pipelines in a cloud environment. Clear written and verbal communication. 

 With more experience: Owns pipeline and platform design end to end, makes sound trade-offs between speed, cost, and reliability, and works independently with client technical teams. 

 At the most experienced end: Leads engineers on a workstream, sets patterns and standards, reviews designs, and builds trust with client stakeholders. 

 Across the range: 
 Experience with at least one modern data platform such as Databricks or Snowflake. 

 Interest in sports, media, entertainment, or consumer data; prior experience with fan, customer, marketing, brand, or media data, including third-party sources, is a plus. 

 Consulting or client-facing experience preferred. 

 Preferred: cloud data certification (AWS, Azure, or GCP); experience with entity or identity resolution, customer data platforms, or data clean rooms. 

 
 We want everyone at CapTech to be able to envision a lasting and rewarding career here, which is why we offer a variety of career paths based on your skills and passions.  You decide where and how you want to develop, and we help get you there with customizable career progression and a comprehensive benefits package to support you along the way.  Alongside our suite of traditional benefits encompassing generous PTO, health coverage, disability insurance, paid family leave and more, we’ve launched extended benefits to help meet our employees’ needs. 
 CapFlex – Employee-first mentality that supports a remote and hybrid workforce and empowers daily flexibility while servicing our clients
 Learning & Development – Programs offering certification and tuition support, digital on-demand learning courses, mentorship, and skill development paths
 Modern Health –A mental health and well-being platform that provides 1:1 care, group support sessions, and self-serve resources to support employees and their families through life’s ups and downs
 Carrot Fertility –Inclusive fertility and family-forming coverage for all paths to parenthood – including adoption, surrogacy, fertility treatments, pregnancy, and more – and opportunities for employer-sponsored funds to help pay for care
 Fringe –A company paid stipend program for personalized lifestyle benefits, allowing employees to choose benefits that matter most to them – ranging from vendors like Netflix, Spotify, and GrubHub to services like student loan repayment, travel, fitness, and more
 Employee Resource Groups – Employee-led committees that embrace and incorporate diversity and inclusion into our day-to-day operations
 Philanthropic Partnerships – Opportunities to engage in partnerships and pro-bono projects that support our communities. 
 401(k) Matching – Generous matching and no vesting period to help you continue to build financial wellness
 CapTech is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering a culture of equality, inclusion and fairness — each foundational to our core values.  We strive to create a diverse environment where each employee is encouraged to bring their unique ideas, backgrounds and experiences to the workplace. For more information about our Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging efforts, click  HERE .
